Flow.description: ALF-RS-04 FR9: "The system should generate the Eval Expert Book-In Sheet from Salesforce after the New Car Sales Representative has entered the required preliminary vehicle details, including make, model, year, mileage, and condition notes." Real gap found 2026-09-08 (user re-read the BRD directly and flagged this as missing). Fires on AppraisalItem create/update once ALL of MakeName/ModelName/ModelYear/Usage(mileage)/ConditionType are populated (no ISCHANGED gate - Flow's ISCHANGED() rejects a TEXT()-wrapped picklist expression as an invalid argument type, so this simply re-checks on every save; Get_Existing_Sheet is the actual duplicate-prevention mechanism). Uses AF_PdfGenerationService (Blob.toPdf(), already built and unit-tested for RS-06's Quote PDF generation but never actually invoked by anything until now) to render a plain HTML layout of the preliminary details and attach it as a ContentVersion on the parent Appraisal. Duplicate-prevention (Get_Existing_Sheet) originally queried ContentDocumentLink filtered on the cross-object field ContentDocument.Title - this deployed clean but caused a genuine "unhandled fault" on every single insert at runtime (confirmed live: the exact same AF_PdfGenerationService call succeeded when invoked directly via anonymous Apex, isolating the fault to that one recordLookup). Fixed by querying ContentVersion directly instead (FirstPublishLocationId + Title, both native fields, no cross-object traversal) - verified live, PDF now generates and attaches correctly, and re-saving the same item without changing Make/Model/Year does NOT create a duplicate. BRD Assumption 3 explicitly flags that "the Eval Expert Book-In Sheet replaces the Trade-In Evaluation Form... to be confirmed during the solution design phase with Alfardan" - the exact layout/branding here is a first-pass placeholder (a plain labeled table, no letterhead), built on user request ahead of that sign-off; expect the HTML body to be revised once the business confirms the real format. AF_InspectionNotes__c (the free-text "condition notes" BRD literally names) is included alongside ConditionType (the structured condition picklist) since the BRD's phrase most closely maps to that combination. Updated 2026-09-08 (LFRDN-631) to read AF_MakeText__c/AF_ModelText__c instead of the standard MakeName/ModelName restricted picklists, which were hidden from the layout since their fixed Automotive Cloud demo values could not be changed. Retargeted 2026-09-08 to Create-only (was CreateAndUpdate with a start-filterFormula gate on all 5 fields being non-blank): live persona testing found that when this flow's Generate_PDF ran on a later Update (the real-world path, since these fields get filled in after initial creation), the same save transaction had already run AF_FL_Appraisal_EvaluationSubmit earlier, which submits the parent Appraisal into AF_AP_Appraisal_Manager for approval - and that approval process's recordEditability=AdminOrCurrentApprover locks the record for everyone except Admin once submitted (queue-based approvers like AF_Q_UsedCarTeam do not reliably count as "current approver" for this lock), so the ContentVersion/FirstPublishLocationId attach failed with INVALID_CROSS_REFERENCE_KEY for the Used Car Team persona specifically (confirmed: identical insert succeeds as Admin, and succeeds in an isolated runAs-as-UsedCarTeam test against the same record before it's locked by approval submission). Rather than loosen the approval process's editability, added AF_VR_ApprItem_RequireCondition (ConditionType had no equivalent to AF_VR_ApprItem_RequireMake/Model/Year/Mileage) so all 5 fields this flow needs are now guaranteed non-blank at Create time via validation rules/required layout fields, letting this flow fire once on Create - before the Appraisal is ever submitted for approval - instead of on a later Update after the lock is already in place. CORRECTION same day: switching to Create-only did not fully fix it, because AF_FL_AppraisalItem_EvaluationComplete is a SEPARATE AfterSave flow on the same AppraisalItem object, fired by the same save (InitialValue being set) and it - not an Update to this flow's own fields - is what reassigns the Appraisal and sets AF_ApprovalStatus__c=Pending, cascading into AF_FL_Appraisal_EvaluationSubmit's approval submission within the SAME transaction. With no explicit triggerOrder on either flow, Salesforce ran EvaluationComplete before this one, so the Appraisal was already locked (AdminOrCurrentApprover) by the time Generate_PDF's ContentVersion insert ran. Fixed by adding explicit triggerOrder: this flow=10, AF_FL_AppraisalItem_EvaluationComplete=20, so the PDF is generated and attached before the Appraisal is ever submitted for approval.
